headline: Riyadh Skyscraper Housing Sovereign Wealth Fund Struck in Suspected Attack
summary: The tallest skyscraper in Riyadh, which houses the kingdom's Public Investment Fund, was struck for the second time in days, resulting in injuries and drawing condemnation from the coalition.
why: Security incidents targeting critical financial infrastructure in Gulf economies can impact regional investor confidence and hydrocarbon asset valuations.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: A major financial tower in the capital was physically impacted.
